newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Matsushima buys stake in U.S. coal miner.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Matsushima buys stake in U.S. coal miner.

text.p: Mitsui Matsushima Co Ltd said on Monday it paid $5 million for a 22.5 percent stake in Bowie Resources Ltd, a U.S. coal mining company, in an effort to expand its overseas coal mine development business.

Mitsui Matsushima said in a statement it hopes to sell coal to Japan from Bowie's number two mine, which has yet to be developed but is targetted for annual production of two million tonnes of coal once it comes on line.

The company said the agreement with Bowie, signed on January 31, would come into effect after the Colorado state government approves development of the number two mine. Approval is expected in April, a company spokesman said.
Bowie Resources, based in Colorado, currently produces 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes of coal annually at its number one coal mine.
Mitsui Matsushima is a diversified coal trading company.
